title: Rows to Markdown table
summary: Render columns and rows as a Markdown table.

values.out:
{"markdown":"| Order ID | Customer | Total | | --- | --- | --- | | 007 | Smith, J | 12.50 | | 008 | Lee
Unit 4 | 3 | | 009 | | x | "}

sections.use: Show a table as Markdown, for a report or a reply. Feeds naturally from csv_to_rows, sort_and_dedupe_rows or table_from_text.
sections.exclusions: No alignment, widths or formatting of numbers.
sections.limitations:
Up to 10,000 rows and 200 columns. Backslashes and bars are escaped and line breaks become
. Every row must have one cell per column.
sections.missing_data: No rows gives the header and separator lines only.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.columns: The column names, as a JSON list of strings.
inputs.rows: The rows, as a JSON list of lists of strings.
